emptyState.title: Start a new conversation
emptyState.description: Choose a working directory for this session
emptyState.orJustType: Or just type a message below to start with the current directory

templates.title: Quick Templates
templates.subtitle: Pick a template to get started, or edit directly in the input box
templates.footerHint: When opened from the input box, selecting inserts text; other entries copy to clipboard

explain.title: Explain Code
explain.desc: Break down a file or snippet in plain language
explain.prompt: Please explain what this code does, its key logic and design intent, and point out anything to watch for.

review.title: Code Review
review.prompt: Please review this code, focusing on correctness, readability, performance and edge cases, with actionable suggestions.

fixBug.title: Fix a Bug
fixBug.desc: Find the root cause and a minimal fix
fixBug.prompt: I'm hitting a bug — help me find the root cause and a minimal fix; explain first, then show the change.

tests.title: Write Tests
tests.desc: Add tests covering key paths and edges
tests.prompt: Please write unit tests for this code, covering key paths and edge cases, and explain the intent of each case.

refactor.title: Refactor
refactor.prompt: Please refactor this code without changing its external behavior, improving readability and maintainability, and explain the changes.

docs.title: Generate Docs
docs.desc: Produce clear comments and usage notes
docs.prompt: Please generate clear documentation and usage notes for this code, including parameters, return values and examples.

feature.title: Implement Feature
feature.desc: Break down the requirement and build it
feature.prompt: Help me implement this feature: break it into steps first, then provide the code with necessary explanations.

commit.title: Commit Message
commit.prompt: Based on the current changes, generate a conventional commit message and briefly explain the reasoning.

token.title: Connect GitHub
token.description: Enter a GitHub Personal Access Token to browse your repositories
token.hint: The token is stored only in this browser and never sent to the server. Requires repo read access.

repos.title: Your repositories
repos.subtitle: Pick a repository to start AI coding

error.unauthorized: Token is invalid or expired, please enter a new one
error.loadFailed: Failed to load, check your network and retry
error.worktreeConflict: Target directory already exists and is not a git repository
error.enterSession: Failed to create session, please retry

inputBox.replyToAgent: Reply to Agent (type @ to mention, / for commands)

shareDialog.title: Share Chat
shareDialog.publicLinkDesc: Anyone with this link can view this chat session.

permissionDialog.autoApproveEnabled: The frontend temporarily remembers Always allow rules. Refresh to clear them.
permissionDialog.changePermissionSettings: Always allow is handled by the backend. You can change this in settings.

inputFooter.autoApproveSession: Auto-approve: this session · click for all sessions
inputFooter.autoApproveGlobal: Auto-approve: all sessions · click to disable

sidebar.addProjectDesc: Add a project to browse recent chats by folder.

sidebar.batchDeleteSessionsConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} session(s)? This action cannot be undone.
